<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me check what the white dots are and try clicking on things
seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Get player position
player = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O':
        player = n
        break

if player:
    b = player['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
    pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
    print(f"Player: row={pr}, col={pc}")

# Get all white objects
white_objects = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W']
print(f"\nWhite objects: {len(white_objects)}")
for n in white_objects:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    r = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
    c = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
    print(f"  Color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, row={r}, col={c}, boundary={b}")

# Get bird positions
yellow_birds = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 3]
print(f"\nBird count: {len(yellow_birds)}")
for b in yellow_birds:
    b_rows = [p[0] for p in b['boundary']]
    b_cols = [p[1] for p in b['boundary']]
    br = (min(b_rows)+max(b_rows))/2
    bc = (min(b_cols)+max(b_cols))/2
    print(f"  Bird: row={br}, col={bc}")

# Try clicking on the nearest bird
if yellow_birds:
    nearest_bird = None
    nearest_dist = float('inf')
    for b in yellow_birds:
        b_rows = [p[0] for p in b['boundary']]
        b_cols = [p[1] for p in b['boundary']]
        br = (min(b_rows)+max(b_rows))/2
        bc = (min(b_cols)+max(b_cols))/2
        dist = ((br - pr)**2 + (bc - pc)**2)**0.5
        if dist < nearest_dist:
            nearest_dist = dist
            nearest_bird = (br, bc)
    
    print(f"\nNearest bird: row={nearest_bird[0]}, col={nearest_bird[1]}, dist={nearest_dist:.1f}")
    print(f"Trying to click on nearest bird at row={int(nearest_bird[0])}, col={int(nearest_bird[1])}")
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': int(nearest_bird[0]), 'col': int(nearest_bird[1])}])
    
    # Check result
    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
    yellow_birds2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 3]
    print(f"After click: birds={len(yellow_birds2)}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
